mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC realized variation, a completed eight-hour Binance premium-index path that spends at least three quarters of its minutes strictly on one side of its causal historical baseline represents persistent leveraged crowding rather than a transient premium impulse. Fade an upper-tail occupied premium and buy a lower-tail occupied discount for eight hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of current eight-hour mean premium minus the causal median of prior block means
mechanism.why_distinct: Premium catchup uses premium displacement opposite BTC return; premium-change autocorrelation uses changes; premium acceleration compares intrahour halves; premium snapback uses a 30-minute high-turn path that already recenters; the funding/premium classifier fits a multivariate score. HVPOCR uses the duration-like occupation of a fixed eight-hour path above or below a causal block-mean baseline plus a two-sided deviation tail. It uses no BTC return direction, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, targeting July-like unstable markets
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: new onsets of offset eight-hour premium occupation tails at 05:05/13:05/21:05 UTC are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.premium_block: exact 480 bars_binance_premium BTCUSDT one-minute closes [D-8h,D), finite signed values with complete unique grid
features.block_mean: arithmetic mean of the 480 signed premium closes
features.causal_baseline: median of at most 270 strictly prior source-valid block means; minimum 180; current excluded
features.deviation: block mean minus causal baseline, strict nonzero
features.occupation_share: fraction of current 480 premium closes strictly above the causal baseline
features.persistent_side: upper when occupation share>=0.75; lower when occupation share<=0.25; middle ineligible
features.deviation_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute deviation against at most 270 prior deviations; minimum 180; current excluded; rank at least 0.70
features.btc_variation: sum squared log(close/open) over exact 1440 BTCUSDT one-minute bars [D-24h,D)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 270 prior source-valid decisions; minimum 180; current excluded; rank at least 0.65
features.trigger: false-to-true onset of persistent side, deviation tail, and variation gate against previous source-valid decision
features.invalid: missing, duplicate, nonfinite premium, incomplete or incoherent/nonpositive BTC OHLC, or sign disagreement between deviation and persistent side; no imputation

clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes after decision
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent duration-like premium occupation crowding mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90 audit; no baseline, block, occupation, deviation, history, rank, variation, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
